purpose: Provide a Physarum/vascular-style selective data tube from JANUS to a very large remote ZIP/ZIP64 archive without downloading the entire object and without revealing member names or contents before the scientific freeze permits it.

blind_shape.rule: EXTENSION_AND_SIZE_METADATA_MAY_GUIDE RESOURCE PLANNING BUT MUST NOT BE TREATED AS SCIENTIFIC OUTCOME EVIDENCE

physarius_semantics.analogy: Grow a thin vessel toward a large nutrient source, sense the vessel geometry first, then thicken only the branch that carries requested information.
physarius_semantics.probe: touch one byte and verify random access
physarius_semantics.index: read the ZIP/ZIP64 tail and central directory rather than the full body
physarius_semantics.member_id: SHA256 of raw ZIP member-name bytes; permits selection without printing the name
physarius_semantics.pull: fetch only the selected member's compressed byte interval, decompress locally, verify CRC32, emit SHA256 receipt
physarius_semantics.fallback: FAIL_CLOSED if Range is ignored, ZIP structure is unsupported, selector is ambiguous, CRC fails, or output guard is exceeded

technical_limits: selective extraction supports stored method 0 and deflate method 8
hosted GitHub Actions pull is guarded to avoid uncontrolled large artifacts
very large ND2/TIF members should be consumed on a self-hosted/NAS runner or through additional chunk-aware format adapters rather than uploaded as one GitHub artifact
next_gate: Use only blind index metadata to freeze an eligible member-selection rule. After scientific feature/score/split freeze, pull the selected member by member_id and create a CRC32+SHA256 byte receipt before any content interpretation.
